module.purpose: Defines type definitions for offline transaction handling including mutation parameters, serialized representations, storage adapters, retry policies, and error classes for the @tanstack/offline-transactions package.
module.summary: This file provides comprehensive TypeScript type definitions for offline transaction management. It defines extended mutation function parameters with idempotency keys, serialized and in-memory transaction representations, storage diagnostics, configuration interfaces, and a custom error class. The types support offline-first data synchronization patterns with retry mechanisms, leader election, and pluggable storage backends.
module.businessContext: Enables offline-first data operations for React Query-based applications. Critical for mobile/web apps requiring data persistence during network outages. Failure breaks offline data sync and retry capabilities.
classes: NonRetriableError (~L172-179): Custom error class marking mutations that should not be retried on failure.

Callers must implement StorageAdapter methods to handle async storage operations
Callers must provide valid idempotencyKey to prevent duplicate mutations
